g1.necessity: The Host verifier must compare GitHub branch protection required checks to an independently protected main policy, not to a candidate PR-supplied allowlist.

g2.authority_owner: GitHub protected main owns policy and workflow blob identity; GitHub API owns check-run identity; separate operator-owned Host signer owns Ed25519 private key and independently verified local receipts.
g2.non_duplication: Reuse existing CI jobs and Host verifier schema; no new Goal/Lane ledger or self-signed CI policy. Initial PR #51 protected bootstrap is an explicit one-time exception because old main lacked the new verifier.

model_evidence: Original PR #51 independent GLM-5.3-Flash read-only Reviewer PASS P0/P1=0; full R9 exit 0; CI run 43916121173 SUCCESS.
New policy is five exact app/context/workflow pins; local 77 Host/CI verifier tests PASS.
No Host ELIGIBLE verdict is claimed before separate issuer deployment and a fresh signed authoritative snapshot.
g3.recovery_or_reason: If a check identity, workflow blob, main SHA, PR merge identity or signed local snapshot changes, fail closed with HOLD; do not bypass protected main.

g4.rollback: Protected revert PR for policy; retain independent audit of first bootstrap and do not delete signing keys without operator-approved rotation.
